warning: This is not legal advice. Counsel must determine applicable law and review the actual app before launch.

controls.title: Data inventory
controls.action: Map personal data purposes collection retention processors and region.
controls.evidence: Data inventory and data flow map.

controls.title: Live accurate privacy policy
controls.action: Link a true policy consistent with real collection sharing and deletion.
controls.evidence: Live public and in-app links plus current data inventory.

controls.title: Tracking consent and opt-out
controls.action: Test pixels analytics and reject or withdraw behavior by market.
controls.evidence: Browser network traces before consent after reject and withdrawal.

controls.title: California opt-out and GPC
controls.action: Assess CCPA applicability sale sharing and required opt-out signals.
controls.evidence: GPC and opt-out tests plus counsel applicability map.

controls.title: Privacy rights requests
controls.action: Assess access correction deletion opt-out and other rights by jurisdiction.
controls.evidence: Rights request flow and redacted test records.

controls.title: SDK and AI data sharing
controls.action: Audit processors and AI vendors for data transmission policies and retention.
controls.evidence: SDK inventory contracts disclosures and traffic tests.

controls.title: Deletion and retention
controls.action: Test account/data deletion and retention representations.
controls.evidence: Delete test across storage backups and policy.

controls.title: Session replay masking
controls.action: Check consent and mask sensitive input to avoid recording secrets and PII.
controls.evidence: Vendor configuration masking evidence and counsel analysis.

controls.title: Third-party fonts
controls.action: Check cross-domain font calls and consider self hosting.
controls.evidence: Network trace and font-host inventory.

controls.title: No exposed secrets
controls.action: No server keys or private credentials in browser bundles or public repos.
controls.evidence: Redacted scan and bundle assessment.

controls.title: Server authorization
controls.action: Test protected APIs and cross-account authorization with dummy identities.
controls.evidence: Protected-route matrix and safe authorization tests.

controls.title: Database and storage permissions
controls.action: Review Supabase RLS and storage or equivalent authorization protections.
controls.evidence: Policies and authorized or unauthorized tests.

controls.title: Login account protection
controls.action: Use proper password handling rate limiting recovery and session security.
controls.evidence: Managed auth configuration and safe tests.

controls.title: Backups and incident preparedness
controls.action: Separate environments and verify restoration and breach response.
controls.evidence: Environment diagram and test restore.

controls.title: Independent security review
controls.action: Obtain source-first security audit and retest confirmed risks.
controls.evidence: Dated report findings and verifications.

controls.title: COPPA applicability
controls.action: Assess child-directed service or actual knowledge of under-13 data before collection.
controls.evidence: Audience and data review parental notice and counsel sign-off.

controls.title: Commercial email obligations
controls.action: Check postal address accurate headers unsubscribe and timely opt-out.
controls.evidence: Campaign sample footer suppression and opt-out test.

controls.title: SMS marketing consent
controls.action: Review phone marketing consent obligations by market.
controls.evidence: Source and scope of recorded consent plus opt-out test.

controls.title: Truthful marketing claims
controls.action: Substantiate ratings testimonials prices AI and product claims.
controls.evidence: Claim ledger testimonial permissions and actual offer.

controls.title: Subscription renewal disclosures
controls.action: Review trial price cadence consent and cancellation under state or store rules.
controls.evidence: Checkout screenshots consent records cancellation test.

controls.title: Transparent charges and refunds
controls.action: Display material fees and refund terms accurately before checkout.
controls.evidence: Checkout receipt refund policy and screenshots.

controls.title: App store payment rules
controls.action: Evaluate digital purchase IAP requirements and permitted exceptions.
controls.evidence: Platform policy mapping and purchase test.

controls.title: Payment processor scope
controls.action: Avoid collecting card data directly and assess PCI scope.
controls.evidence: Payment dataflow and processor agreements.

controls.title: User content terms
controls.action: Clarify uploader rights granted license and moderation policy.
controls.evidence: Upload UX agreement and moderation process.

controls.title: DMCA safe harbor review
controls.action: If relying on 512 protections evaluate designated agent and notice process.
controls.evidence: Counsel analysis agent registration if appropriate.

controls.title: Licensed assets and brand
controls.action: Verify image font code music copy and trademark rights and permissions.
controls.evidence: Asset license inventory and approvals.

controls.title: AI generated content rights
controls.action: Review provider terms training data output similarity and distribution rights.
controls.evidence: Model terms and asset review.

controls.title: Privacy in mobile apps
controls.action: Provide policy within app and store listing with accurate data disclosures.
controls.evidence: iOS Android screens and store metadata.

controls.title: Mobile account deletion
controls.action: Provide effective deletion in-app if accounts can be created.
controls.evidence: Actual delete flow and backend result.

controls.title: Accessible use
controls.action: Test critical keyboard screen reader mobile and contrast journeys.
controls.evidence: WCAG-guided manual and automated test evidence.

controls.title: Terms assent and EULA
controls.action: Determine applicable terms and have counsel approve; securely track versioned assent where needed.
controls.evidence: Legal approvals and consent recording tests.

controls.title: Support and business identity
controls.action: Provide genuine contacts and required business identification.
controls.evidence: Support route and public footer.

controls.title: AI transparency and accuracy
controls.action: Map AI inputs outputs safeguards provider sharing and claims.
controls.evidence: AI risk review evaluation and data flow.

controls.title: Regulated features counsel gate
controls.action: Seek specialty review for health kids biometrics finance employment or education.
controls.evidence: Qualified counsel signoff scoped to feature and market.

controls.title: EU GDPR territorial scope (Art. 3)
controls.action: Assess EU establishment, intentional offering of goods/services to people in the EU/EEA or monitoring behavior there; mere website accessibility is not conclusive.
controls.evidence: Business location, targeting languages/currencies, audience markets, tracking geography and signed legal applicability decision.

controls.title: Purpose-by-purpose lawful basis (Arts. 5–6)
controls.action: Inventory each personal-data processing purpose and document an appropriate lawful basis before processing; consent is not the universal basis.
controls.evidence: Processing-purpose matrix, basis rationale and product-flow traces matched to each purpose.

controls.title: Transparent privacy notices (Arts. 12–14)
controls.action: Review controller identity, purposes and basis, recipients, retention, international transfers, rights, complaints and information received from other sources.
controls.evidence: Actual signup/collection screens and current policy cross-checked against data map and vendor list.

controls.title: Data subject rights (Arts. 15–22)
controls.action: Evaluate access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection and relevant automated-decision rights with identity checks, exceptions and response workflow.
controls.evidence: Redacted test cases for rights intake, deadlines, export, correction, deletion, denial reasoning and processors.

controls.title: Consent proof and withdrawal (Art. 7)
controls.action: Where consent is the selected lawful basis, verify specificity, affirmative choice, recordkeeping and withdrawal as easy as giving consent.
controls.evidence: Consent UX, versioned audit record, no-prechecked boxes and before/after withdrawal trace.

controls.title: Privacy by design and retention (Arts. 5, 25)
controls.action: Check purpose limits, minimization, access restrictions, default privacy settings and justified retention/deletion across systems.
controls.evidence: Field-to-purpose map, defaults, permission matrix, retention schedule and redacted deletion tests.

controls.title: Controller–processor contracts (Art. 28)
controls.action: Identify controller/processor roles; examine mandatory processor terms, subprocessors, instructions, assistance and vendor safeguards.
controls.evidence: DPA list, role matrix, subprocessor approvals and redacted signed processor clauses.

controls.title: Third-country transfers (Chapter V)
controls.action: Identify restricted transfers and examine current adequacy, SCC or other valid mechanism and supplementary assessment where needed; avoid assuming EU-hosted means no transfers.
controls.evidence: Data-flow map by recipient country, actual contractual mechanism and transfer risk assessment.

controls.title: DPIA screening and high-risk processing (Art. 35)
controls.action: Screen for likely high risk (including large-scale sensitive data, systematic monitoring or certain profiling); perform a DPIA before processing when required.
controls.evidence: Risk-screening worksheet, risk rationale, approved DPIA or defensible reason none is needed.

controls.title: Personal-data breach response (Arts. 33–34)
controls.action: Check breach classification, documented escalation and supervisory notification generally within 72 hours when likely risk; affected-person notice when high risk, subject to exceptions.
controls.evidence: Incident runbook with controller/processor roles, timed tabletop exercise and notification decision log.

controls.title: Records of processing (Art. 30)
controls.action: Assess whether controller/processor processing records are required, accounting for limited small-organization exceptions.
controls.evidence: Current processing-activities record or counsel-documented exemption analysis.

controls.title: DPO and EU representative screening (Arts. 27, 37)
controls.action: Assess whether DPO or EU representative appointment rules apply; neither role is universal for small apps.
controls.evidence: Establishment and processing-risk rationale, appointments/contact details where required.

controls.title: Profiling and automated decisions (Art. 22)
controls.action: Examine solely automated decisions with legal/similar significant effects, relevant safeguards and information rights; do not assume every AI feature meets the threshold.
controls.evidence: Model-purpose map, decision impact assessment, human review and contestability flow where required.

controls.title: Special-category personal data (Art. 9)
controls.action: Check whether processing includes Article 9 categories and document both an Article 6 basis and Article 9 condition if applicable.
controls.evidence: Data taxonomy, collection/feature traces, legal conditions and security/access evidence.

controls.title: EU terminal storage and tracking consent
controls.action: Identify cookies, pixels, SDKs and similar device storage/access; test consent before non-exempt uses and justify genuinely necessary exceptions under applicable national laws.
controls.evidence: Fresh-profile network and device-storage trace before choice and after rejection, plus classified tracker inventory.

controls.title: EU choice design and consent withdrawal
controls.action: Verify informed, granular and freely given choices; Reject and withdrawal work technically; review dark patterns and national rules.
controls.evidence: UX screenshots, preference-change traces, consent records, vendor list and no-prechecked controls.

controls.title: UK GDPR scope and 2025 DUAA amendments
controls.action: Independently assess UK GDPR territorial reach and the DUAA 2025 amendments now in force, including complaints and children's higher protection requirements where relevant.
controls.evidence: UK market/monitoring screening, purpose map, applicability memo and dated legal guidance.

controls.title: UK lawful basis, rights and complaints
controls.action: Document UK GDPR bases and exemptions (including amended recognized-legitimate-interest provisions), rights process and usable data-protection complaint route.
controls.evidence: UK data processing/basis map, privacy notices, rights-request and complaint flow test.

controls.title: UK PECR cookies and similar technologies
controls.action: Apply current UK PECR rules, including DUAA exemptions and any simple-means-to-object requirement; do not blindly reuse EU banner logic.
controls.evidence: Storage/access inventory, exception rationale, before/after browser trace and user objection test.

controls.title: UK restricted international transfers
controls.action: Screen separately for UK restricted transfers and assess adequacy, UK IDTA/Addendum or other appropriate safeguard with transfer risk assessment when applicable.
controls.evidence: UK transfer map, controller/processor roles, current agreements and safeguard decisions.

controls.title: UK children-likely-to-access privacy defaults
controls.action: For online services likely accessed by children, review age-appropriate design and DUAA children's higher protection matters.
controls.evidence: Audience research, privacy defaults, children's risk review and counsel analysis.

controls.title: US state privacy-law applicability map
controls.action: Review state-by-state applicability thresholds, exemptions, definitions, sensitive-data and controller obligations; California rules are not a substitute for every state.
controls.evidence: US-state reach matrix, customer counts, revenue/data-sharing facts, exemptions and counsel confirmation.

controls.title: California 2026 risk, audit and ADMT regulations
controls.action: Screen CCPA-covered businesses for risk assessments, cybersecurity audits and ADMT significant-decision duties; evaluate size, revenue, processing, thresholds and phased compliance dates separately.
controls.evidence: Business eligibility assessment, applicable processing/threshold facts, ADMT significant-decision screening, compliance calendar and risk/audit evidence.

controls.title: State opt-outs and sensitive-data controls
controls.action: Review applicable state rights, targeted-ad/sale opt-outs, recognized preference signals such as Colorado UOOM/GPC, and consent for sensitive data where required.
controls.evidence: State-specific rights matrix, GPC/UOOM and delete/export test, advertising/vendor inventory.
